label: Lemma EmptyEssL of Gödel's 1970 variant: at every world, the empty property is an ESSENCE_1, in the…
meaning: Discriminating consequence, from the definition alone: in Gödel's 1970 variant the empty property is an essence of every individual at every world (AFP lemma EmptyEssL). Its counterpart for Scott's essence is SCOTT-EMPTY-PROPERTY-NOT-ESSENCE; the two definitions differ exactly by the conjunct that the bearer has its essence, and this result is the step of GOEDEL-1970-INCONSISTENT that the difference makes available. Formal consequence inside the Lean embedding of the AFP theory (DEF-HOML-ACTUALIST-NECESSITY) only: it shows nothing about what Gödel intended, how his manuscript developed, nor whether the axioms are true.
